race.description: Geely At John Oxley Motors Hcp (C2)
race.comment: ROCKIN' MILLIE (2) has been kept fresh since running a below par twelfth over 1200m at Tuncurry when going back from the tricky gate. Can race much closer today and assess on the solid third two back. LAIZABOUT (7) back-marker who needs plenty of luck in his races. Gave away a considerable start with the 59kg when hitting the line strongly to run fourth over 1200m at Scone. Will appreciate the weight drop and figure prominently. EX WIFE (1) holding his form this time in and has genuine winning prospects from the low draw. Covered ground in the run and never surrendered with a tough second over 1008m at Taree. Suitably placed and anticipating a big run. HARD JAKKA (6) win record hardly excites and drops 4.5kg for this. Strong through the line with an eye catching second over 1204m at this track. Can play a leading role.
